name: ceramics-api

dependencies.description: Stores products, carts, orders, and order items.
dependencies.name: ceramics-db

dependencies.description: Validates the caller's bearer token and resolves their role (Shopper vs Store Admin) for every protected operation.
dependencies.name: user-auth

config.description: Stripe secret API key used to charge the shopper's card at checkout.

dependencies.description: Charges the shopper's card during checkout via Stripe's REST API; the store never stores raw card numbers.
dependencies.name: stripe

dependencies.description: Sends the order-confirmation email after a successful checkout. No specific transactional-email vendor is named in the requirements.
dependencies.name: email-provider

description: Ballerina service owning the product catalog, cart, checkout, and order lifecycle. Marks a product sold and delists it the instant it's purchased, charges the card via the payment provider, and sends the order-confirmation email. Enforces that only the Store Admin role can manage listings or update order status, and that a shopper can only see their own orders. Does not handle sign-in itself (delegates to Thunder) and does not integrate with any shipping carrier.
